{{Quote|It's a Forcesaber, weapons of the Force Hounds of the Rakata.|Xesh to Daegen Lok|<ref name="DOTJ 6" />}}
The '''Forcesaber''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] invention in which powerful [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] energy was channeled through laboratory-grown [[Color/Legends|ebon]] crystals in glowing energy blades, able to be ignited like the much later developed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==History==
A [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] experienced by [[Daegen Lok]] during his travel into the [[Rift|Chasm]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] showed him a blade made of fire that had never been seen before. His dark vision saw the [[Je'daii Master]]s banish him to the moon of [[Bogan]]. Lok would only discover that the weapon was called a Forcesaber when the Force Hound [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] had been exiled to the Tythonian moon. He would ask the Force Hound to construct a new Forcesaber in order to show it as proof of his vision to the [[Je'daii Order]].

==Description==
[[Force Hound]]s were required to construct these weapons, which required the use of a special form of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] along with the use of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemy]] to shape it. The process involved the construction of a hilt and the presence of adequate resources for the task. Some Forcesabers, the ones used by Force Hounds, were like regular [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], while others, used by [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] themselves, were similar to [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pikes]].

Forcesabers, like later models of lightsaber, came in a variety of colors. Xesh and Daegan Lok both utilized purple, [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill]] a light blue. In Lok's vision, a shadowy army of warriors were seen to wield red, while in [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] Master [[A'nang]]'s and Xesh's flashbacks, Rakatan warriors seemed to favor orange.<ref name="DOTJ 9" /> The [[Flesh Raider]]s, mutated Rakata themselves, used yellow.<ref name="DOTJ 11">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 1]]</ref>

The basic principles of this technology would later be developed into the [[Protosaber|prototype lightsabers]] used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="DOTJ 0" />
